cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: The GitHub repository GamerD11/ping_test hosts the install-time payload of the malicious npm package dependencykfeg (25.0.3, 25.1.3, 25.1.9), which declares a dependency resolved directly from `https://github.com/GamerD11/ping_test/raw/refs/heads/main/node-acct-utils-1.0.0.tgz`. The repository was created on 2026-10-29 and contains only that tarball and `burp_collaborator.txt`, which holds the current Burp Collaborator (oastify.com) collector host name. The tarball's `preinstall` script runs `node index.js`, which collects the username (`whoami`), hostname, home and working directories, platform, architecture and Node.js version and sends them to an oastify.com host. The first version (commit aab6519c20, tarball sha256 af59a1f75fb309422693a656404504c4ab7c25d31a70bf0c36cf2454dea35f43) sent an HTTP POST to `yrtew6v4g3w9myixyizv5cvfa6gx4zso.oastify.com`; the version committed on 2026-10-29 at 22:01 UTC (commit e74e024638, tarball sha256 2707f1c7c853cd703495678ade5e3819a98620f5f6b6ca247b962d727b3ff84a) reads the collector host from `burp_collaborator.txt` at run time, adds the machine's public IP address, network operator and ASN from `https://ipinfo.io/json`, and sends everything in an HTTPS POST with certificate verification disabled. Because the npm packages fetch the tarball from the mutable `main` branch, the repository owner controls the code that runs on every machine that installs them. The repository has no other content or purpose.

files.note: payload tarball v1 (commit aab6519c20): preinstall HTTP POST of user, host and paths to oastify.com
payload tarball v2 (commit e74e024638): adds ipinfo.io lookup, HTTPS POST to the host in burp_collaborator.txt
